description: Lists a webhook's recent deliveries: what was sent and what came back.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Send it with the same params as the first page (`limit` may change); a page whose params differ is a 400 naming the param.

from.description: Only deliveries created at or after this moment: `YYYY-MM-DD` or a UTC timestamp (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`); a date-only value starts at the beginning of that UTC day. Delivery history is retained for 90 days; deleting a webhook deletes its delivery history with it.

status.description: Filter by delivery status (one or a comma list). Values: pending, delivered, permanent_failure.

to.description: Window end (deliveries created up to this moment): same value grammar as `from`. A date-only value covers that whole UTC day. A timestamp is included until 2027-01-12 and exclusive from then, as everywhere else (Deprecations). `from` after `to` is a 400. See Time windows.

name: tickerbot_list_webhook_deliveries
